name: mangled-tool-input
about: The provider emits a tool call whose arguments are not valid JSON: a step that ended on `length` with the object half written. Two live turns on 2026-09-12 died this way, which is why `repairToolInput` exists. Truncated bytes are not an object, so `repairToolCall` returns null. **Until 2026-10-05 that ended the turn as `error`**, and this transcript recorded it (KI-2026-09-16-a), but not because the SDK aborted the run: AI SDK 7 turns an unrepairable call into a tool error the model reads, and the run goes on. What ended it was our own `onError`, which the UI stream calls to word every tool error and which latched the record as `error`. With the failure recorded only on a real `error` part, the turn now completes: the model reads the error and answers, all three steps are counted, and no proposal exists because the one write never ran. A scripted mock cannot produce this input (it is well-formed by construction), which is KI-11's structural point.

source.from: the two aborted live turns of 2026-09-12 (repairToolInput's own note)
